name: CM Helpline 181
department: Public Grievance Redressal Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh
beneficiary: All citizens, farmers, students, and residents of Madhya Pradesh
benefits: Direct lodging of citizen complaints against government departments and tracking time-bound resolution.
eligibility: Citizen seeking departmental resolution or government scheme information
application_process: Dial 181 to register a complaint or register directly via the portal or app.
application_mode: Phone Call / Online Portal / CM Helpline Mobile App
